written_rules: Each position without BRICK FRAME that a saw touches (excluding the initial position) will be evaluated as if HARD HAT symbol had landed there during the FREE SPINS FEATURE, one at a time.
Saws will be generated only after all other frame updates have occurred.
During free spin, before each reel spin initiates, a number of positions may be randomly replaced with HARD HAT, HORIZONTAL SAW HARD HAT, VERTICAL SAW HARD HAT or HAZARD HARD HAT symbols.
During the FREE SPINS FEATURE, if HAZARD HARD HAT symbol lands on an active row, then 1 or more additional rows will become active and remain active for the remainder of the FREE SPINS FEATURE.
During the FREE SPINS FEATURE, if 3 or more SCATTER symbols land on active rows then 1 additional free spin is awarded.
